description: This file provides support for Protocol Buffers message sets, including types, methods for marshaling/unmarshaling, and extension handling.

classes.name: _MessageSet_Item
classes.description: Represents an item in a message set with type ID and message bytes.

classes.name: messageSet
classes.description: Represents a collection of message set items with methods for marshaling, unmarshaling, and management.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds a message set item corresponding to a given message.

methods.name: Has
methods.description: Checks if a message is present in the message set.

methods.name: Unmarshal
methods.description: Unmarshals data into a message, using message set wire format.

methods.name: Marshal
methods.description: Marshals a message into message set wire format.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the messageSet to an empty state.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the messageSet.

methods.name: ProtoMessage
methods.description: Marks messageSet as a protobuf message.
